description: Canonical wrapped reviewer-status lineage used by the reviewer-authority CLI. Proposal and acceptance operations consume the complete predecessor sequence. Production Stage A is separately constrained to the epoch-one genesis acceptance with an exact empty predecessor sequence. The activation driver request v3 contains no reviewer history. Postlaunch activation-input manifest v2 instead binds stageBReviewerStatusHistory as a canonical bare array, not an instance of this wrapped schema: [] means the epoch-one deployment-intent root remains current; selecting a successor requires the exact pinned root followed by every complete successor through the current head, and a lone repeated root is noncanonical. Semantic validation checks every guardian signature, epoch, predecessor digest, nonoverlapping window, monotonic revocation, finite-controller transition, and current-head expiry in order.
title: dnai-wikigen reviewer authority current-status history
